scope: N2.2 replay only the already selected two known profiles, without changing or reranking selection
identity_gate: Check example_pool.json and selection.json against selection_receipt.json before opening outcomes; record their digests plus the method version
mapping: Resolve the two IDs via saved example_provenance.json; no reads of other profiles' boot/events/results
sources: Only selected profiles' archived boot/context and raw QEMU logs, plus the saved configuration identity already checked in N2.1. Inspect existing verify_runtime.py/run_runtime.py parsing functions as necessary, without invoking build/boot/batch mains.
contract: Researcher-reviewed narrow requirement: current secondary CPU belongs to its SMT mask at the archived pre-IRQ content sample in the common scheduler-starting lock path. Actual loop-lock count is supporting diagnostic, not a substitute normative rule.
binding: Require correct revision/architecture/config, CPU1, common CPUHP stage, same sample identity and provenance; do not compare raw mask integers for equality across architecture
unknown: Missing event/context, parser requiring whole-pool read, ambiguous identity or insufficient binding yields insufficiency without manufacturing result
limits: Known-case replay, no new API/build/startup, no new defect or independent selection gain. This sample is not established as the global first actual content read, nor as an interval-stability/concurrency proof. No extrapolation to real SMT, hotplug reentry or unselected profiles.
artifacts: Save selected-replay result, exact log/config hashes, observation coordinates/context, and immutable selection identity; leave saved selector outputs untouched
